judge.notes: The agent executed the call politely and accurately, successfully securing the passenger's target outcome without inventing any facts.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Welcome to British Airways. Please note calls are recorded. For English press 1. For Hindi press 2.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: For flight status press 1. For manage booking press 2. For special assistance press 4.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: To change a flight press 1. For cancellations, refunds and compensation press 3. To repeat this menu press star.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: If your flight was cancelled by the airline press 1. For all other refunds press 2.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for calling. Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] All of our agents are currently busy. The estimated wait time is 8 minutes.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to British Airways, my name is Rahul. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Rahul, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Emily Clarke, and this call may be recorded. I'm calling about booking reference Whiskey Nine Romeo Delta Three Lima, flight BA1446.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for your call, Emily. I can see your booking reference W9RD3L for flight BA1446. Your flight was cancelled due to crew availability. Can you confirm if you're seeking a refund and UK261 compensation?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Yes, I can confirm that. The flight was cancelled with 48 hours' notice due to crew availability, so under UK261 Article 5(1)(a) and Article 8, the passenger is entitled to a full refund of 164 pounds to the original payment method, and under Article 5(1)(c) and Article 7, compensation of 220 pounds for a flight of 534 kilometres. I'd like both of those please.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I understand, Emily. I'll process both the refund and compensation for your booking. Your reference number is 8 Q H 7 8 S.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you, that's great. Just to confirm, the reference number is Eight Quebec Hotel Seven Eight Sierra. Is there anything else the passenger needs to do on her end? Thank you so much for your help, I really appreciate it.
